input: Find private, Montessori, Waldorf and charter school summer camps open to the public for kids and teens in the Asheville area of Western North Carolina (within about an hour of Asheville). Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: Asheville private school summer camp 2026 open public

candidates.name: Asheville Montessori School
candidates.note: 2026 themed Montessori camps introduce new students as well as serving current students.

candidates.name: Black Mountain Montessori
candidates.note: 2026 weeklong camps for ages 3–6; community registration follows enrolled-family priority.

candidates.name: Montessori Country Day
candidates.note: 2025 summer sessions for toddler and primary classrooms include gardening, crafts and splash days.

candidates.name: The New Classical Academy
candidates.note: 2026 weeklong camps open to any rising K4–grade 5 students, including cooking and outdoor adventures.

candidates.name: Asheville Christian Academy
candidates.note: 2026 enrichment and sports camps welcome community children; most sessions are half-day.

candidates.name: Christ School
candidates.note: Basketball and lacrosse camps ran in 2025; 2027 Plumlee basketball camp announced for boys ages 10–17.

candidates.name: Rainbow Community School
candidates.note: Seven weeks of 2026 summer camps for rising grades 1–8; 2027 offerings expected in February.

candidates.name: Evergreen Community Charter School
candidates.note: Evergreen Summer Adventures offered five 2026 weeks, open to area children rising K–grade 9.

candidates.name: IC Imagine Public Charter School
candidates.note: 2026 ASCEND themed camps and basketball, cheer and volleyball camps welcome non-enrolled community youth.

candidates.name: ArtSpace Charter School
candidates.note: Co-presents the public 2026 Creative Arts Camp with Wortham Center in Asheville.

candidates.name: Growing Wild Forest School
candidates.note: 2027 outdoor camps announced for potty-trained ages 3–6, 8:30 a.m.–1:30 p.m.; new families may apply.

candidates.name: Asheville Farmstead School
candidates.note: Camp Farmstead offered six 2026 weeks for potty-trained children through age 12, with gardening and nature themes.

candidates.name: Discovery Trails Learning Academy
candidates.note: Microschool offers summer adventure camps and a separate Reggio-inspired preschool nature camp.
